subject: king cobra
title: Snakes Have No Arms. This One Still Builds a Nest

scenes.text: Snakes have no arms. So how does this one build a nest?
It's the king cobra, up to 18 feet long, the longest venomous snake on Earth.
The female loops her body like an arm and drags dead leaves and soil into a compact mound.
She lays as many as 40 eggs inside, then stays coiled on or beside them for about two months.
She fiercely defends it, and the male often waits nearby.
It's the only snake known to build a nest. No arms, and it still does it.
